name: Tangent Plane-Based Bounding Box Calculation
definition: A two-stage method to calculate an axis-aligned screen-space bounding box for 3D Gaussians in spherical panoramas, addressing deformation caused by omnidirectional pixel distribution and non-linear spherical projection.
summary: Tangent Plane-Based Bounding Box Calculation projects a tangent-space bounding box onto the equirectangular plane to ensure validity despite spherical distortion.
